title: Shared tuning bus
blurb: Retunes three AudioWorkletNode synth voices (C4, E4, G4) from one global-scope tuning message and verifies the rendered pitch via offline zero-crossing frequency measurement.
question: Can a single tuning message posted to AudioWorkletGlobalScope retune multiple AudioWorkletNode voices simultaneously without per-node message fan-out?
result: On Chrome for Testing 153, the labelled bootstrap AudioWorkletNode('tuning-mailbox') fallback retuned C4/E4/G4 and offline pitch measurements matched expected targets (261.63, 327.03, and 392.44 Hz in just intonation). Spec path over audioWorklet.port not verified in Chrome 160.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 153 (labelled bootstrap fallback verified); not verified in Chrome 160
